layout.bio_description: Daniel brings over 12 years of experience in strategic operations and organizational development. Prior to joining our team, he served as a senior advisor for several Fortune 500 companies, focusing on scaling processes and restructuring teams for high growth. With a sharp analytical mind and calm leadership style, Daniel helps businesses simplify complexity and build systems that last.
